patches.before: - No idle SCK edge away from the accepted CPOL level.
patches.after:
- No idle SCK edge away from the accepted CPOL level.
- Accept and first wr/rd on the same edge are legal (command enqueued first). Switch tracking starts at the pending changed offer; old select may release before acceptance. Timing bounds have no tolerance; config-change gap below old+new idle is blocking unresolved.
- Release of a selected segment with bytes outstanding fails; wr/rd while tx_ready/rx_ready=0 fails. Completion requires (LEN+1)*16/lanes SCK edges.

rationale: Accept is processed before handshakes so same-edge accept+wr is legal. Switches are tracked from the pending changed offer, so release before acceptance is handled, and csaat_hold now allows release whenever an offer is pending. The one-cycle tolerance is removed. For config changes, a gap below old+new idle is blocking unresolved. The edge bound is corrected to 2 edges per bit. New checks fail on missing bytes at deselection and on handshakes while not ready. Added positive/negative controls for same-edge accept, early-release switching, missing bytes and too-short bursts; existing controls are kept, with toggle counts doubled to match the corrected edge bound.
